arguments.analyst: O1 and O2 are the brightest observed variants, while O5 is dim despite only three edits; context matters.
arguments.hypothesis: Adding D21E or Y200C to the bright O1 backbone will retain high log brightness, whereas conservative M88V/N144S additions may be less favorable in this context.

decision.analyst: O1 and O2 are the brightest observed variants, while O5 is dim despite only three edits; context matters.
decision.hypothesis: Adding D21E or Y200C to the bright O1 backbone will retain high log brightness, whereas conservative M88V/N144S additions may be less favorable in this context.
decision.critic: Estimates are fitted, not measured; NEW designs carry ~0.5 uncertainty and context-dependent multi-edit effects.
decision.selection_rationale: Prioritize top predicted C01 and N04, then near-tied N01-N03; exclude C02 lowest at 2.478.
